map.💡 公式：FSPL(dB) = 20·log₁₀(d[km]) + 20·log: 💡 Formula: FSPL(dB) = 20·log10(d[km]) + 20·log10(f[MHz]) + 32.44; received power Pr = Pt + Gt + Gr − FSPL
map.FSPL 仅适用于自由空间（视距、无遮挡）的理想场景，实际损耗会更大: FSPL only applies to ideal free-space (line of sight, unobstructed) scenarios; real losses are larger

map.2.4 GHz、1 km 的自由空间损耗: Free space loss at 2.4 GHz over 1 km
map.FSPL = 20log₁₀d(km) + 20log₁₀f(MHz) + 32: FSPL = 20log10(d[km]) + 20log10(f[MHz]) + 32.44 = 20log10(1) + 20log10(2400) + 32.44 = 0 + 67.60 + 32.44 = 100.04 dB; wavelength λ = 2.998×10⁸ ÷ 2.4×10⁹ ≈ 12.49 cm. With Pt = 20 dBm, Gt = 3 dBi, Gr = 2 dBi → Pr = 20 + 3 + 2 − 100.04 = −75.04 dBm. Shortening distance to 100 m drops FSPL to 80.04 dB (20 dB less), raising Pr to −55.04 dBm.
map.为什么距离加倍损耗只加 6 dB？: Why does doubling distance only add 6 dB of loss?
map.自由空间中功率按距离平方衰减，20log₁₀(2) ≈ 6.02 dB。频率同理: In free space power falls off with the square of distance, and 20log10(2) ≈ 6.02 dB. Frequency behaves the same way: 20log10(2) ≈ 6.02 dB, so doubling frequency also adds about 6 dB of loss.
map.实际链路为什么比这个值差？: Why is a real link worse than this value?
map.FSPL 只考虑自由空间扩散，不含大气吸收、雨衰、多径衰落、障碍物遮挡与天线失配: FSPL only considers free-space spreading and excludes atmospheric absorption, rain fade, multipath fading, obstruction blockage and antenna mismatch. Real design must stack these margins on top.
